metadata.description: Landflow Ops & SOC and work integrations: alert triage, Landfall war rooms, threat intel, and Linear, Attio and Fathom activity for the second brain, as node plugins with ready-made flows.

plugins.name: triage
plugins.description: Alert triage that decides whether an alert deserves a war room: normalize Alertmanager, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, Sentry and Wazuh alerts, extract IOCs, parse reported emails, rules people approve, and a fail-open triage decision. Flows: alert and phishing triage into Landfall, and a daily digest.

plugins.name: landfall
plugins.description: Landfall nodes: open, attach and recover incidents from alerts, declare rooms, read and add to timelines, record fixes applied outside Landfall, heartbeats, and a trigger for opened and ended rooms. Flows: workflow failures and a heartbeat into Landfall, and lessons from closed rooms.

plugins.name: threat-intel
plugins.description: Read-only threat intel in Go: VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, GreyNoise, urlscan.io, Shodan, AlienVault OTX and MISP, plus IOC Enrich, which asks all of them at once with a cache and one verdict. Flow: an IOC lookup API.

plugins.name: linear
plugins.description: Linear issues, comments and project updates as activity items: a trigger that registers its own signed webhook, Get Many Changed Since and Get, users with email, and Create Issue, Add Link and Create Comment (nothing that deletes). Flow: work from Linear into the second brain.

plugins.name: attio
plugins.description: Attio records, deals, list entries, notes and tasks as activity items: a trigger that registers its own signed webhook, Get Many Changed Since and Get, workspace members with email, and Note, Task and Add to List actions (nothing that deletes or merges). Flow: deals and notes from Attio into the second brain.

plugins.name: fathom
plugins.description: Fathom meetings and action items as activity items, read-only: a new-meeting trigger that registers its own signed webhook, Get Many Changed Since and Get, summaries, transcripts only when asked, teams and members. Flow: meetings from Fathom into the second brain.

plugins.name: clickland
plugins.description: Clickland observability: search logs and traces, services, metrics, log patterns, alerts, notes, knowledge search and views (dashboards included), a signed alert webhook trigger and a polling trigger. Flows: Clickland alert triage to Slack, and the observability assistant behind Clickland's Assistant panel.
